_meta.note: Drop-in replacement for the MACRO dict hard-coded in invest.py (same keys and structure; extra keys are additive). Values re-checked 2026-10-06 against the latest releases (NSO 9M/Q3-2026 report and Sep-2026 CPI of 03/10/2026; MoF public-investment disbursement to 30/09/2026). All via search-engine excerpts: nso.gov.vn, mof.gov.vn and press pages are blocked from the sandbox. Changes vs invest.py: public_invest.plan_bn 991,931.6 -> 1,022,607 (the 62.9% headline rate is of the full plan; 991,931.6 is the plan excluding the 5% local reserve for the Lao Cai-Hanoi-Hai Phong railway, on which the rate is 64.8%, now in plan_ex_rail_bn / pct_ex_rail); gdp.q4_required_est 12.5 -> 12.6 (same formula, rounded correctly). Refreshed by Economy after each NSO monthly release (next: 03/11/2026).

gdp.q4_required_method: Approximation, not an official figure: Q4 assumed ≈ 28% of annual real GDP, so required Q4 ≈ (10 − 9.01 × 0.72) / 0.28 = 12.55%. For comparison, the World Bank's 7.4% for 2026 (EAP Update, 06/10/2026) implies Q4 ≈ 3.3% on the same approximation.
gdp.period: Q1–Q3 2026 and 9M-2026 vs same period 2025, constant prices; NSO estimate released 03/10/2026. Target: NQ 244/2025/QH15 (≥10%).
gdp.verified: search-engine excerpt, 2026-10-06; same values as data/economy.json ECONFLOW.gdp.growth_real_pct

public_invest.plan_note: plan_bn = total 2026 plan assigned by the NA/PM (central 372,380.4 + local 650,226.6); 642,961.6 / 1,022,607 = 62.9%. plan_ex_rail_bn excludes the 5% local reserve (30,675.4) for the Lao Cai–Hanoi–Hai Phong railway; rate 64.8%.
public_invest.source: Bộ Tài chính, lũy kế đến 30/09/2026

cpi.target_source: NA 2026 socio-economic plan resolution NQ 244/2025/QH15: CPI ~4.5% — https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/thong-qua-nghi-quyet-ve-ke-hoach-phat-trien-kinh-te-xa-hoi-nam-2026-119251113123708302.htm
cpi.period: CPI Sep-2026 vs Sep-2025 (yoy_sep); Jan–Sep 2026 average vs same period 2025 (avg9m, core9m); NSO release 03/10/2026
